Some solutions stop at answering the phone. Smith.ai answers every call, qualifies every lead, books the consultation live on the call, and captures the details your team needs directly into your CRM. One system, from first ring to active case.
Answering rate x booking rate = more signed cases

+80% increase in booking rate with Smith.ai vs. an in-house solution
We optimize your law firm’s conversion funnel
1. Answer & Qualify
Calls answered, 24/7. Caller type is identified to handle accordingly.
Callers are qualified based on your firm’s specifications. No more time wasted on unqualified leads.
2. Intake & Book
Intake is specific to firm and practice area. Capture the right information based on the caller’s matter. Complete and consistent intake, every time.
Consults are booked live on the call. 77% of callers say yes when asked to schedule a consult. We make sure to ask.
Complex or urgent matters are routed. Transfer the call to your team or one of our Live Agents immediately when needed.
3. Sync & Convert
Always — case synced to CRM. Transcript, summary, and intake data are sent to the right people and places.
Case-by-case — next steps. Action items, booking confirmation, or retainer agreement sent.
The cost of an understaffed or undertrained front office goes beyond missed revenue.
Incomplete or inconsistent intake wastes time. Conflicts and unqualified leads take up valuable slots on your calendar.
Converting clients is unbillable. Every minute a paralegal spends taking a first call is a minute off a billable case.
Urgent matters can’t wait until the office opens. Arrests and emergencies need attention now, not Monday at 9am.
A bad caller experience damages your reputation. Don’t let a missed or fumbled call be your firm’s first impression.
Answer first. Qualify right. Win the client.
Smith.ai answers first and books the consultation before your prospect calls a competitor.
Book a consultation · Get started for free
Tailored to your practice areas and intake process, not a generic script.
Tell us what’s important, and we’ll build the right flows for every practice area and case type. Callers get off the phone feeling heard and ready for next steps.
Personal injury — time-sensitive, high-value
Qualify: Where did the incident occur? Who was at fault? What is the extent of the injuries sustained?
Capture: date of incident; treatment status; insurer contact; current or prior counsel; driver, passenger, or pedestrian.
Convert: book consultation; send retainer agreement. Explore personal injury law solutions
Family law — sensitive, safety-aware
Qualify: What type of case is this regarding? Are any children involved? Which state and county are you located in?
Capture: ages of children; contested or not; opposing party; filing status; assets involved; court date or deadline.
Convert: collect consultation fee; book consultation. Explore family law solutions
Criminal defense — nights and weekends
Qualify: When and where did the arrest occur? What are the charges?
Capture: case type; court date; defendant name; caller name; caller relationship to defendant.
Convert: attempt transfer; book consultation. Explore criminal defense solutions
Estate planning — patient, document-led
Qualify: Are you calling regarding your own documents, or those of a significant other? What type of assets are you looking to protect? What is the estimated value of the estate?
Capture: document type; new or existing; upcoming deadlines; number of dependents.
Convert: book consultation.
Immigration — bilingual by default
Qualify: Are you or the person you’re calling for currently detained? What is your current immigration status?
Capture: case type; country of citizenship; date entered US; upcoming hearing or deadline; primary language.
Convert: schedule consultation; transfer to firm.
Employment law — screened against your standard
Qualify: Are you the employer or employee? What is the nature of the employment complaint? Is this related to a protected class?
Capture: proof or documentation; name of employer/company; position/title of employee; salary or hourly wage.
Convert: book consultation; send retainer agreement.
The best of AI. The best of humans. Working as one.
Our unique hybrid solution gives you the best of both worlds. You get coverage without compromise, quality without cost, and a system that improves on every call.
Three ways to staff your intake.
100% AI — fast and efficient, with some limitations
Hybrid solutions — maximum flexibility, control, and cost efficiency
100% Human — warm and skilled with nuance, but harder to scale
AI-first — starting at $1.60/call
Answers on the first ring, day or night. Handles routine intake, books the consult, and humans are always available to step in. Try it free before you commit. AI Receptionist
Hybrid — starting at $2.50/call (most firms start here)
AI handles the routine, live agents handle the complex. Every call gets what it needs, and you never overpay. Choose your mix for the smartest version of coverage. Hybrid
Human-first — starting at $7/call
A dedicated North American team that learns your firm, your attorneys, and exactly how your team does intake. Virtual Receptionist
Key features included in every plan
Practice-aware intake — intake flows tailored to every practice area you serve, so you always capture the right details.
Lead qualification — qualified leads are identified by the most desirable case attributes, specified by you.
Appointment booking — convert more leads by scheduling consultations live on the call, no follow-up required.
Payment collection — require consultation fees to be paid upfront so only the most sincere leads get time on your calendar.
Retainer sending — send contingency agreements for e-signature right after a qualified lead call.
Human escalation ($3 extra) — your most complex and valuable calls handled by our Live Agent Network.
Warm transfers — callers routed to your team with full context for a professional end-to-end experience.
Bilingual fluency — conversational fluency in English and Spanish, so you can serve a more diverse client population without bilingual front-office staff.
Native & custom integrations — direct connections to your CRM, calendar, and practice management tools, eliminating manual data entry.
Call recording & transcription — instant call summaries keep you in the loop, with full records available for every call.
Spam screening & blocking — over 20 million known robocalls and solicitors automatically blocked, so your team can focus on real callers.
Dashboard & analytics — see how your intake is performing over time through call volume, appointments scheduled, call quality scores, and more.

Try it out again. Call again with a different matter to experience a completely different intake.
Punch above your weight class. Enterprise-grade quality and support.
The caliber of infrastructure, intelligence, and service usually reserved for the big companies, now available to you. Our Quality Flywheel is a self-reinforcing improvement loop built to ensure every call is better than the last.
Quality — we get it right. Accurate, dependable, and always improving. Every call makes the next one better.
Flexibility — we get it right your way. Your AI and human balance. Your custom playbooks and integrations. Your industry-specific logic.
Support — we do it for you. Experience a level of service excellence smaller businesses usually can’t access.
The Smith.ai Quality Flywheel
Train — load your procedures, policies, and knowledge base. Key Words ensure the AI understands your industry’s specific terminology — not just generic speech patterns.
Test — LLM-as-a-judge evaluation runs alongside human reviewers. Thousands of synthetic simulations, reviewed by people, build confidence in complexity before deployment.
Deploy — every call with your AI receptionist feeds the system. Voice quality, transcription accuracy, and conversational UX are monitored in real time by AI and human reviewers across AI and live agent interactions.
Analyze & improve — CSAT signals, unanswered FAQs, and quality trends are processed automatically and reviewed by humans, then fed back into Train. The loop compounds. Every call widens the moat.
Quality is our moat. Humans are our unfair advantage. Our system trains, tests, deploys, and improves in parallel, around the clock, with humans in the loop at every stage.

Questions firms ask us first
Can Smith.ai replace my intake staff?
Most firms use Smith.ai to supplement their intake staff, so teams can spend more time on the relational client work once qualified leads are retained. We’re here to empower legal teams to get back to the work they’re meant to do, with fewer interruptions.
Do the receptionists give legal advice?
No. Our receptionists never give legal advice. They are trained to feel like an extension of your firm, but legal advice is left to the attorneys and legal team.
Can Smith.ai turn away matters we don’t take?
Yes. Out-of-practice-area callers are identified during qualification and, per your instructions, can be referred to a bar association or another firm, so your team only spends time on valuable conversations.
Will my callers know they’re talking to AI?
Yes, you can customize your AI Receptionist to follow your firm’s bar rules and disclosure preferences, and it never claims to be human when a caller asks directly. With Virtual Receptionist, every call is answered by a real, live agent from the start.
What happens when the AI can’t handle a call?
For complex calls, our AI seamlessly hands off to a human receptionist from our Live Agent Network, so the caller reaches a real person instead of a dead end.
Who decides what gets asked on the call?
We do the heavy lifting. Smith.ai’s call flows are built from patterns refined across 25M+ calls and more than a decade of legal intake, so your firm starts with a system already shaped by what converts, not a blank script. Our playbooks are customizable, so flows can be further tailored to your firm’s established intake flow.
Can you run conflict checks?
Our live agents can check callers against your existing contacts and matters during qualification.
What happens to confidential caller information?
Call data is encrypted and stored within the dashboard, protected by your logged-in credentials, to protect your privacy and confidentiality. Call recordings are deleted after three months.
What if the receptionists get something wrong?
Built-in oversight is part of our system. Every call runs through our Quality Flywheel (train, test, deploy, improve), and if something needs to be corrected on your setup, our world-class CS team can ensure it’s optimized going forward.
How much work is this to set up on our end?
Setup depends on the complexity of your firm’s needs, but our years of intake expertise make the process smooth. Most law firms are up and running in a few days.
What does this cost, and what am I actually paying for?
AI Receptionist runs about $1–2 per call, Virtual Receptionist about $6–10 per call, and Hybrid about $2–5 per call. You pay per call, not per minute, so a long new-client call costs the same as a short one.
Can you integrate with my practice management system?
Yes. We integrate natively with Clio, MyCase, Lawmatics, Filevine, and 7,000+ other tools — updating contact records, logging every call as CRM activity, and pulling case status in real time.
Can Smith.ai receptionists book consultations, or do they just take a message?
Both. We’ll take a message if that’s what your firm wants, but we can also book consultations directly on your calendar the moment a caller qualifies, so nothing waits on a callback.
Is it okay for a service outside our firm to handle end-to-end intake?
Yes, with the same oversight any firm applies to nonlawyer intake staff. Under ABA Rule 5.3, a supervising attorney is expected to confirm any outsourced intake service acts consistently with the firm’s professional obligations, which is why our playbooks are built to your firm’s needs rather than open-ended. (General awareness, not legal advice, since state bar rules vary.)
Can you complete my intake forms?
Yes. Your firm’s specific intake fields and qualifying questions can be built into every onboarding call, so all the information you need lands directly in your practice management system, already organized.
Can you reschedule my appointments?
Yes, appointment management works both ways. If a client needs to reschedule a consultation, we can do so directly on your calendar, just as we book.
Can you make outbound calls?
On Virtual Receptionist plans, our live agents place outbound calls to confirm appointments, return missed calls, follow up on leads, or relay time-sensitive updates. If follow-up calls matter to your firm, ask about Virtual Receptionist plans or Hybrid plans rather than AI Receptionist alone.

Frequently asked questions
Why does your answering service cost more than the competition?
Our AI answering service costs a little bit more because it does a lot more.
Unlike others offering AI that stops at answering basic questions (assuming they even get them right, which most don’t), you can trust us with your business’ reputation.
First, we have humans in the loop. With our AI Receptionist, your calls are always handled by our AI first, but if something complex comes up, the call can be transferred to a live North America-based receptionist — any time, day or night. This built-in human backup ensures your callers get the help they need while you never get interrupted. It’s the perfect blend of efficiency and reliability.
Second, our system is designed specifically to qualify your leads based on our industry-leading experience answering over 20 million calls for businesses in the past 10 years. So yes, it’s a bit pricier than the competition — because we’re committed to making every interaction exceptional.
Do spam calls count towards my quota?
Every call answered by your AI Receptionist counts toward your call quota by default. Smith.ai offers AI Receptionist customers an allowance to remove up to 10% of their calls from their bill each billing cycle to account for selected spam calls. Calls from 20 million+ known spammers are automatically filtered out by our system before your AI Receptionist answers, and these calls do not count toward your quota. You can learn more about this here .
How do you determine if calls are spam?
With technology! Our system automatically blocks over 20 million spam and robocalls from ever getting through. If a new spam number does get through, you can mark it as spam to automatically block the caller and add it to your spam list, so it can’t get through ever again.
Do I have to sign a contract?
No. AI Receptionist is a month-to-month service. This means there aren’t any long-term contracts. You pay for the AI Receptionist service each month. If you ever cancel, we need 30 days’ notice, and then you’re done. And we will miss you.
Can I change my plan?
Yes, at any time. We make it easy. If you would like to change your plan, just email support@smith.ai . We’ll start billing for your new plan the next month.
Why do you bill by the call?
Because unlike per-minute services, our success is aligned with your success. Billing per call means there’s no mystery accounting involved. You’re trusting us to represent your business. We’re optimized for the exact right length of calls, not more or less. Per-minute services work opposite to your needs; they want to maximize your call length while you want to minimize your call time.
How is this worth it?
Do you want your business to succeed? Well, good. We do, too. A successful business can’t afford to miss a single lead or sales opportunity. (By the time you call them back, they’ve likely found someone else… or if they’re really bad, they’ll leave a negative review because you didn’t answer.) Our AI Receptionist isn’t just another AI; it’s the only one on the market designed specifically for lead qualification and on-demand escalation to Smith.ai’s 24/7 Live Agent Network. If your callers need more than our AI can handle, AI Receptionist can immediately transfer them to an experienced live agent at your discretion. No missed calls, no frustrated customers — just flawless support. And here’s the best part: it’s a fraction of the cost of an in-house receptionist, yet it works 24/7 and never takes a lunch break. So, you’re not just paying for an answering service; you’re investing in a solution that’s always on, always reliable, and always working for you.
Do you offer discounted plans?
We offer volume discounts and can create a custom plan to suit your high-volume needs. Please book a free consultation with our team.
